properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 21 at 1:39AM PDT until October 22 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* WHAT...Snow above 8000 feet. Snow accumulations of 4 to 8 inches
with up to 10 inches along the highest mountain peaks. Ridge winds
gusting as high as 40 mph at times.

* WHERE...Mono County.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 5 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Wednesday evening and Thursday morning
commutes.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Brief bursts of heavy snow and locally higher
snowfall totals will be possible with any thunderstorms that
develop today and Thursday.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM THIS MORNING TO 5 PM PDT THURSDAY ABOVE 8000 FEET
